run.title: {{period}} billing run

kpi.invoicesHint: One per account and payer · {{accounts}} accounts
kpi.exemptHint: Assessed at zero, shown, not missing

run.readOnly: Posted runs are read-only. A wrong amount is corrected with a credit note on the invoice; nothing is edited.

why.maker_checker_required: You prepared this run, so someone else must approve it.
why.stale_preview: Charges changed after the preview. Generate it again first.
why.permission_missing: Your role doesn't include this step.
why.invalid_transition: This step isn't available at this stage.
why.posting_policy: The site’s posting policy names other roles for posting.

next.draftText: Every flat is assessed with the rules in force. Nothing is billed until the run is approved and posted.
next.staleTitle: The preview is out of date
next.staleText: Charges, exemptions or payers changed after it was generated. It can't go further until it is generated again.
next.staleWaiting: Charges changed after the preview. The preparer must generate it again before anyone can approve it.
next.previewedTitle: Check the flats, then send for approval
next.previewedText: {{count}} invoices for {{amount}}. The treasurer approves; you can't approve your own run.
next.approveText: Prepared by {{name}}. Check the flats and exceptions, then approve, or return it with a comment.
next.waitingText: The committee treasurer decides. You'll see the result here.
next.postText: Approved by {{name}}. Posting creates the invoices; it is safe to repeat and can't be undone.
next.notifyText: {{count}} invoices are posted. Notifying residents is simulated in this demo; nothing is sent.
next.doneText: {{count}} notices recorded as sent (simulated). Payments arrive in the next stage.
next.cancelledText: Nothing was billed. A new run can be created for the month.

done.postReplay: Already posted: the same {{count}} invoices, nothing new created.

confirm.postEffect: This creates {{count}} invoices for {{amount}}, one per account and payer. Posted invoices can't be edited; corrections are credit notes.
confirm.returnEffect: It goes back to {{name}} with your comment, who can change it, preview again and resend it.
confirm.cancelEffect: Nothing has been billed. The run stays in the history as cancelled.

summary.noPreview: Generate the preview to see the totals.

checks.title: Checks
checks.description: What the server checked before this run can go ahead

rules.ok: Charge rules are in force for the month
rules.block: No maintenance rule is in force for the month

no_payer.ok: Every billed flat has a responsible payer

opening_balances.warn: Opening balances are not approved yet

declared_flats.warn: {{count}} flats registered; this differs from the declared number

stale.block: The preview is out of date

items.title: Assessment by flat
items.description: Each flat's charges, who pays and which rule set them. Open a flat to see the rules it overrode.
items.empty: Generate the preview to see every flat.
items.search: Find a flat, payer or account
items.key: Posting key {{key}}: posting it again finds this line and creates nothing new.

exceptions.exemptHint: Approved exemptions: assessed at zero and listed, never silently left out.
exceptions.overridesHint: A rule more specific than the site default won (for example the penthouse rate).
exceptions.sharedHint: One account covers flats with different payers, so each payer gets their own invoice.
exceptions.noPayerNone: Every flat has a responsible payer.
exceptions.noPayerSome: These flats block the run until a payer is recorded.

approval.rule: {{name}} prepared this run. Only a different person with the approver role can approve or return it; the server checks this by person, not by name.

posting.title: How posting works
posting.idempotent: Posting is safe to repeat: a double click, a retry or a repeated request finds the lines already posted and creates nothing new.
posting.grouping: One invoice per billing account and responsible payer; each line keeps its flat and the rule that set it.
posting.locked: After posting the run is read-only. Corrections are credit notes on the invoice.
posting.notify: Notifications are simulated in this demo. Nothing is sent to anyone.
posting.result: {{count}} invoices posted on {{date}}. Repeated post requests recorded: {{replays}} (nothing duplicated).
posting.more: and {{count}} more in the invoice list

import_flats.title: Import the flat register
import_flats.yours: Bring in all 80 flats with their owners, occupants and payers.
import_flats.waiting: The building manager imports the flat register first.

approve_opening_balances.title: Opening balances to approve
approve_opening_balances.yours: Check the total carried over from the old register, then approve or return it.
approve_opening_balances.waiting: Waiting for the committee treasurer to approve them.

create_run.title: Prepare the {{period}} bills
create_run.yours: Create the billing run, preview every flat and send it for approval.
create_run.waiting: The building manager prepares the run.

preview_run.title: Preview the {{period}} run
preview_run.yours: Generate the preview to see every flat's charges before anything is billed.
preview_run.waiting: The building manager is preparing the preview.

submit_run.title: Send the {{period}} run for approval
submit_run.yours: The preview is ready. Check it, then send it to the treasurer.
submit_run.waiting: The building manager is checking the preview.

approve_run.title: Approve the {{period}} run
approve_run.yours: Prepared by someone else. Review the flats, then approve or return it.
approve_run.waiting: Waiting for the committee treasurer. You prepared it, so you can't approve it.

post_run.title: Post the approved {{period}} run
post_run.yours: Approved. Posting creates one invoice per account and payer; it can't be edited afterwards.

notify_run.title: Tell residents about their {{period}} bills
notify_run.yours: Invoices are posted. Notifications are simulated in this demo; nothing is sent.
notify_run.waiting: Invoices are posted; residents are not notified yet.

stale_run.title: The {{period}} preview is out of date
stale_run.yours: Charges, exemptions or payers changed after the preview. Generate it again before it goes further.
stale_run.waiting: Charges changed after the preview; the building manager must refresh it.

returned_run.title: The {{period}} run was returned
returned_run.yours: The approver returned it with a comment. Fix, preview again and resend.
returned_run.waiting: Returned to the building manager with a comment.

finish_setup.title: Finish setting up the society
finish_setup.yours: A few setup steps are still open.

review_proofs.yours: Match each to the bank and verify, ask for information or reject.

proofs_waiting_resident.yours: Residents were asked for more information.
proofs_waiting_resident.waiting: Residents were asked for more information.

reconcile_bank.yours: Match transfers to proofs, or set aside what is not a resident’s payment.

approve_beneficiary.title: New collection account to approve
approve_beneficiary.yours: Proposed by someone else. Check the bank letter, then approve or reject.
approve_beneficiary.waiting: Waiting for the committee treasurer. Residents keep the current account.

approve_payer_changes.yours: Requested by someone else. Check the dates, then approve or reject.

apply_credit.yours: Apply it to open charges of the same payer, or keep it for the next bill.

approve_payment_exceptions.yours: A transfer matches a proof only in part. Check the reason, then approve or reject.

proofs_awaiting_bank.title_one: {{count}} proof waiting for its bank line
proofs_awaiting_bank.title_other: {{count}} proofs waiting for their bank line
proofs_awaiting_bank.yours: Import the next statement; each is verified when its transfer appears.
proofs_awaiting_bank.waiting: Finance verifies each when its transfer appears.

approve_data_exports.yours: Someone asked for a copy of the organisation’s data. Check what it holds and why, then approve, narrow or reject.
approve_data_exports.waiting: Waiting for someone who can approve exports.

portal_invitations_expired.yours: They were not accepted within 14 days. Resend them, or print invitation codes.

household_requests.yours: Residents asked to add people to their flat. Verify each one before they are listed.

dashboard.subtitle: {{period}} billing · today is {{date}}
dashboard.collectedLater: Recording residents' payments and proofs comes in the next stage. No figure is shown until real payments exist.
dashboard.tasksSubtitle: Your work first, then what waits for someone else
dashboard.tasksEmpty: Nothing waiting. Everything for this month is done.
dashboard.runSubtitle: Prepared, approved by someone else, then posted
dashboard.noRunBody: No run for {{period}} yet. Each month's bills start as a draft you preview flat by flat.
dashboard.approvalsSubtitle: Every approval is made by someone other than the person who prepared it
dashboard.laterBody: These parts of a society are planned and shown here so nothing looks finished before it is.

statement.title: Statement
statement.rule: The previous balance is carried forward on the statement; it is never added to an invoice as a line.
statement.empty: No invoices or credits in this month.

charges.noRules: No charge applies to this flat for the month.
charges.intro: The charges Al-Noor bills each month and every rate version, by month. A rate is changed as a new version from a month, never edited.
charges.otherHint: Available to societies but not set up at Al-Noor, or coming in a later stage.

actions.openingImported: imported opening balances of {{total}} for {{accounts}} accounts
actions.openingApproved: approved opening balances of {{total}} for {{accounts}} accounts
actions.payerCorrectionRequested: asked to correct a payer change
actions.proofVerifiedManually: verified a payment proof by hand

runs.intro: Each month's bills: prepared and previewed, approved by someone else, then posted.
runs.goLive: Went live this month: arrears from the old register were imported as opening balances.
runs.emptyBody: Create the first run for the month to preview every flat.
runs.supplementary: A flat or charge missed after posting will be billed with a supplementary run (posting version 2, new lines only). Supplementary runs are planned for a later stage; until then, correct amounts with credit notes.

problems.beforeGoLive: The first month billed here is {{period}}.

newRun.intro: Choose the month and check what the run will use. Creating the run bills nothing; you preview every flat next.
newRun.later: Can be prepared ahead; {{period}} is still open
newRun.scope: The whole site: {{site}}, {{flats}} flats in {{buildings}} blocks.
newRun.scopeLater: Billing only some blocks is planned for a later stage.
newRun.checksHint: Each line opens the screen behind it.

checks.noRules: No maintenance rule is in force for this month
checks.pendingExemptions: {{count}} exemption request still waits for a decision ({{approved}} approved)

newRun.existingShort: There is already a run for this month.

errors.makerChecker: You prepared this, so someone else must approve it.
errors.stalePreview: The preview is out of date. Generate it again first.
errors.invalidTransition: That step isn't available at this stage.
errors.duplicatePeriod: There is already an open run for this month.
errors.noRules: No maintenance charge is set up for this month.
errors.noPayer: Some flats have no responsible payer.
errors.postedLocked: A posted invoice can't be edited. Correct it with a credit note.
errors.postingPolicy: Your role is not one the site allows to post runs.

accounts.intro: One account per flat, or per owner when one person holds several flats. Each flat keeps its own payer.

account.liableHint: Who is liable for this flat, with dates. History is kept.

rules.intro: Site defaults apply to every flat; a block, a flat type or a single flat can have its own rate. The most specific rule wins, and exemptions apply after that.
rules.listHint: In force from {{period}} unless shown otherwise.
rules.defaultsHint: Every flat pays these each month from {{period}}, unless a more specific rule or an exemption applies.
rules.suggestedNote: Suggested from the committee's current rates; change any amount before saving.
rules.addHint: For a block, a flat type or one flat. It wins over the site default for those flats.

levelHint.unit_type: Every flat of a type, e.g. penthouses

rules.versionHint: This makes a new version from the month you choose. Months already billed keep the old amount; a preview made before the change goes out of date.
rules.whichHint: For any flat and {{period}}: the rule that sets each charge, and the rules it overrode.

problems.scope: Choose what the rule applies to.
problems.periodPosted: That month is already billed. Choose {{period}} or later.
problems.overlap: A rule for this charge and scope already exists. Change it instead.
problems.beforeVersion: A new version can't start before {{period}}.

exemptions.intro: A full or partial exemption for a flat, with a reason. It applies only after someone other than the requester approves it, and an exempt flat still appears in every run at zero.
exemptions.emptyBody: No flat is exempt from any charge.
exemptions.waitingMine: You requested this, so someone else decides.
exemptions.confirmEffect: {{percent}} % off from {{period}}. Runs previewed before now will need a new preview.
exemptions.rejectEffect: The flat keeps paying its charges.

problems.reason: Give a reason of a few words.
problems.exists: This flat already has an exemption from that month.

invoices.intro: Every invoice the association issued, monthly bills and opening balances alike, with where each came from.
invoices.emptyBody: Try another filter. Monthly bills appear once a run is posted.

invoice.previousNote: The account's previous balance is not part of this invoice; it is carried on the statement. The account owes {{balance}} in all.
invoice.payeeHint: The association's verified account, as printed on the bill.

creditNote.title: Credit note for {{ref}}
creditNote.subtitle: Correct a posted invoice without editing it
creditNote.rule: Enter what to credit on each line (at most what is still open) and why. The invoice stays as issued; the credit note and the statement show the correction.

problems.reason: Give a reason of a few words.
problems.noLines: Enter an amount on at least one line.
